**Valmont depot handover**

Established: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts; certified June 2023, renewal due June 2028. Ops lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. 410 daily departures; winter peak 530; cancellations 1.8%. Brake check every 6000 km. Parts store: 1100 line items; contract renegotiated Nov 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.

Failed/fixed: Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4200.

Rules: fuel card needs second approval above €200; part above €500 needs two quotations; route change needs 7 days' notice; incident report within 24 hours; roster needs one named publisher.

Planned: second charging bay Q3; electrification study approved, unfunded.

Open: night shift understaffed; old ticketing terminal on 3 routes; May 2026 double roster left 2 shifts uncovered; winter peak capacity unmodelled. Training: 11 days, revised April 2026.
